description: Dual-bit dual-supply bus transceiver, per-bit direction, common output enable, 3-state outputs
note: Pinout sn74axc2t245 p.2 Table 4-1 (RSW: 1 DIR2, 2 OE, 3 GND, 4 B2, 5 B1, 6 VCCB, 7 VCCA, 8 A1, 9 A2, 10 DIR1; DIR1 controls A1/B1, DIR2 controls A2/B2); sn74avc2t245 p.3 Figure 4-1/Table 4-1 and sn74avc2t245-q1 p.3 same numbers. Function table sn74avc2t245 p.12 / sn74axc2t245 p.20 (each transceiver): OE L, DIRx L -> B to A; OE L, DIRx H -> A to B; OE H -> isolation. DIRx and OE referenced to VCCA.

AVC.note: Max A->B at VCCA = 3.3 V, VCCB = 3.3 V (nearest row to 3.3<->5 V; no 5 V supply; no typical printed), SN74AVC2T245 (sn74avc2t245 p.9). VCCA and VCCB 1.2-3.6 V, VI 0-3.6 V (sn74avc2t245 p.4-5)

AXC.note: Max tpd A->B at VCCA = 3.3 V, VCCB = 3.3 V, -40 to 85 C (nearest row to 3.3<->5 V; no typical printed), SN74AXC2T245 (sn74axc2t245 p.13). VCCA and VCCB 0.65-3.6 V, VI 0-3.6 V (sn74axc2t245 p.4)
